title: In JetBrains Datalore before 2026.4 account takeover was possible via SSO sign-in to a pre-registered account…
description: JetBrains Datalore versions prior to 2026.4 contain a vulnerability that allows account takeover via SSO sign-in to a pre-registered account. This issue enables an attacker to gain unauthorized access to user accounts through the single sign-on mechanism. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.8, indicating a medium severity level.
